essence: The construction is established by placing the five seeds in reverse order.
The knowledge must be guarded with the utmost secrecy, like one's own womb.
Even the greatest sacrifices are permissible, but the seed-sixteen must never be disclosed.
The Bālā-primary knowledge is kept concealed in all scriptures.
Although it must be well concealed, it has been revealed out of affection.
